title: The zones with lights of their own: res/lighting/zones/zones.json
description: The last file of ARCID_ZONE_LIGHT_TABLE (a/0/8/1), ZONE_LIGHT_TABLE_FILE in zonedata.c: the zones lit by a lighting set of res/lighting/zones/ instead of their area's, a ZoneValue each, which GetZoneStaticLightDataIndex searches in order for FieldLightStatus_Get and the sunny weather. tools/data/zone_light_data.py packs it.
